test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

KRVI : NUYL :: AHMQ : ?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

• KRVI : NUYL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29c6256a8b85c87354bca99e0d0a58bb458987cd9e27b1907c39dae6f9d03462.png] 

Similarly, AHMQ : DKPT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496d4575cba095fbb40df253802deac45a932534c14ed44f449db6143438f3a6.png] 

Hence, **'option 1' **is the correct answer.
